summary_en: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. It was pretrained on 23.8T tokens and features a 1M-token context window via a novel two-stage midtraining phase. Post-training involved a large-scale asynchronous RL campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts in 4 weeks. Beam achieves frontier-level reasoning with 3-4x less inference compute than comparable models, and includes FP8/NVFP4 quantization and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2). It refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests.
summary_zh: Beam 是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数 501.3B，激活参数 23.4B，专为编码、推理和智能体工作负载优化。它基于 23.8T 高质量 token 预训练，通过新颖的两阶段中期训练实现 1M token 上下文窗口。后训练采用大规模异步强化学习（RL），在 10.5K 块 GB300 GPU 上运行 4 周，生成超过 1 亿次 rollout。Beam 以比同类模型少 3-4 倍的推理计算量达到前沿推理水平，并集成 FP8/NVFP4 量化和 1.93B 参数的推测解码器（DFlash 2）。在有害请求上拒绝或转移率为 88.9%，在无害请求上合规率为 81.5%。
content_en: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.
content_zh: Beam 是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数量 501.3B，激活参数量 23.4B，专为编码、推理和智能体工作负载构建并优化。Beam 提供前沿水平的推理能力，同时所需推理算力比同类许多模型少 3-4 倍。Beam 在 23.8T 多样、精选、高质量的 token 上预训练，具备 1M token 上下文窗口，该窗口通过新颖的两阶段中期训练阶段实现，构建于可验证、以正确性为锚的数据之上。后训练利用了跨 10.5K GB300 GPU 的大规模、全异步强化学习（RL）训练，在 4 周训练中生成超过 100M 次 rollout。我们相信这是迄今为止任何开放实验室进行的最大规模 RL 运行之一。在我们的评估套件中，随着我们增加 RL 算力，能力持续提升，没有出现平台期的迹象。在深度硬件-模型协同设计、FP8/NVFP4 量化和 1.93B 参数投机解码草稿模型（DFlash 2）的支持下，Beam 通过高效、灵活的部署最大化服务吞吐量。在对话轮次和危害类别上平均，Beam 对 88.9% 的有害请求拒绝或转移，同时遵从 81.5% 的无害请求，在 Pareto 前沿上的开放权重模型中实现了对有害请求的最高拒绝/转移率。
